messages:
Maria (AE): Morning team :wave: quick standup from me —
1) Pipeline: demo with MacroHealth at 11am PT, POC agreed for 3 nodes, potential $180k ARR if pilot converts.
2) Blockers: MacroHealth legal flagged encryption-at-rest proof and SAML metadata. Need security attachment for the SOW.
3) Today: prepping demo + sending requested security pack. Ping @Sam for the encryption blurb and any SAML tips.

Olivia (SDR): Heads up — One inbound from Finalyze yesterday, interest in Dedicated for compliance. Intro call set for Tue.

Sam (Security): @Maria good morning — I can draft an encryption-at-rest one-pager and a short SOC2 excerpt. For SAML we need the SP metadata and ACS URL. Do they want IdP-initiated too?

Maria (AE): Prefer both, they asked for IdP-initiated. I'll paste their ACS/Entity in a follow-up.

Jess (Sales Ops): If we attach the security pack to the SOW we should include the standard data processing addendum. I can attach template v3.2. Should I copy legal@redwood?

Maria (AE): Yes please copy legal. Also tagging @Raj for a quick Q on Dedicated sizing: MacroHealth expects 30 concurrent inference sessions, 8k tokens peak per session. Is the 3-node POC sensible? :thinking:

Raj (Eng): For 30 concurrent sessions with 8k tokens peaks, 3x A100-ish nodes will be tight depending on batching. For POC it's fine if we set token limits and enable KV caching. I'll add a note about fallback model variants if latency spikes. I'll post a short config snippet.

Raj (Eng): ```
# suggested POC settings
model_variant: rdx-13b-quant
max_tokens_per_request: 8192
kv_cache: enabled
batch_window_ms: 20
fallback_policy: region_then_variant
```

Sam (Security): Sending encryption blurb now —
"Redwood encrypts customer data at-rest using AES-256 with customer-managed keys available via KMS/HSM integrations. Access to keys is logged and limited by RBAC. We support VPC deployment for additional network isolation."

deploy-bot: Deployment notification — security-pack v1.2 uploaded to /shared/sales/security-packs at 1710605100

Olivia (SDR): Quick note — MacroHealth wants SSO testing during POC week 2. Can we reserve an engineer for a 1-hour setup call? @Raj

Raj (Eng): I can carve out 60 minutes Wed 10am PT for SSO setup. Please add to my calendar and include their SAML metadata.

Jess (Sales Ops): Legal copied, sent template v3.2 and DPA. Maria, check your inbox, I also attached the security one-pager.

Maria (AE): Great, thanks everyone. Action items for me: send ACS/Entity, schedule demo follow-ups, confirm POC start date. Blocking on two docs from @Sam and @Jess (now resolved). I'll update the CRM and ping again if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:

Sam (Security): If MacroHealth requests pen test reports, we only share redacted summary — flag me and I'll coordinate with infosec.

Maria (AE): Noted. End of standup from me. Anyone else?

Olivia (SDR): No blockers. I'll prep the Finalyze info and add to the pipeline board.

Raj (Eng): No blockers beyond SSO window. Will post the config to the POC doc.

Jess (Sales Ops): Nothing else. Closing my items.

Maria (AE): Cool — thanks team :pray:
